claims: Carl’s Jr. primarily operates on the West Coast.
Carl’s Jr. is owned by CKE Restaurants Holdings, Inc.
Carl’s Jr. has over 1,000 U.S. locations.
CKE Restaurants Holdings, Inc. is based in Franklin, Tennessee.
CKE Restaurants Holdings, Inc. operates Hardee's.
Friendly Franchisees Corporation filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in April 2026, citing high labor costs and declining sales, impacting 65 locations.
Carl’s Jr.'s signature items include Famous Star, Western Bacon Cheeseburger, Hand-Breaded Chicken Tenders, and biscuits.
Carl’s Jr. is known for in-car curbside pickup, mobile app deals, and $5 All Star Meals.
Carl’s Jr. offers burgers including Single/Double/Triple Famous Star, Big Carl, Guacamole Bacon Burger, and El Diablo.
Carl’s Jr. offers sides including fries, onion rings, and fried zucchini.
Carl’s Jr. offers hand-scooped ice cream shakes.
Carl’s Jr. has restaurants in 28 countries.
